description: This Java class 'InMemoryEdqsQueueFactory' implements the 'EdqsQueueFactory' interface, providing in-memory queue creation methods for the EDQS component, including consumers, producers, and response templates, with some methods throwing UnsupportedOperationException.

classes.name: InMemoryEdqsQueueFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating in-memory queues and related components for the EDQS system, implementing the EdqsQueueFactory interface.

methods.name: createEdqsEventsConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for EDQS events using in-memory storage.

methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; not supported in in-memory implementation.

methods.name: createEdqsResponseTemplate
methods.description: Creates a response template with in-memory queues, handling request-response communication for EDQS.
